Prime Minister Narendra Modi visits Manila from November 16 to 18 for the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and 21st East Asia Summit. India’s agenda centres on maritime, economic and development cooperation, with bilaterals and a possible Quad meeting on the sidelines.
